H. de Vere Stacpoole, The Blue Lagoon.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/h-de-vere-stacpoole/the-blue-lagoon

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- H. de Vere Stacpoole, an author, died 1951.

First publication of the text used: 1908 (SE colophon: 'The Blue Lagoon was published in 1908 by Henry de Vere Stacpoole.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1908. The edition's own statement of rights (quoted below) says the text is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die did so in 1951, so the text is public domain in each of them.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
